dimensions.note: Methods log entry/completion, replay suppression, degraded evidence, and transitions without sensitive values.
Input and persisted-state validation completes before evaluation writes; transition markers are committed last.
Synthetic tests cover open/resolve transitions, replay suppression, freshness, malformed input/state, and write ordering.
Inspection IDs and incident/intent names are deterministic; unchanged replays return no handles.
No external API calls or provider clients.
No network connections, subprocesses, files, or temporary resources.
README and tests use generic synthetic identifiers only.
All persisted resources and accepted snapshots use strict schemas; public method schemas strip evaluator-injected global arguments before strict execution validation.
Every resource declares an intentional lifetime and garbage collection count.
Transition evaluator, not a CRUD lifecycle model.
No provider mutation, delivery, remediation, or network capability.
Plan, inspection, subject, incident, and intent names are deterministic and spec-distinct.
Stored state is accessed only through readResource.
